newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals hold steady on limited arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals hold steady on limited arrivals.

text.p: Indian base metals held steady in a narrow range on Wednesday on limited imports, dealers said.

Ready copper was steady at 12,750 rupees per quintal. It was down by 50 rupees on Tuesday against a rise of 300 rupees last week. Fresh offerings by the state-owned Hindustan Copper remained limited and this agency also withdrew cash discount of two rupees per kg which was offered last month, they said.
Tin remained steady at 35,000 rupees on thin supplies and stray physical support. It rose by 100 rupees on Tuesday.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,300 rupees, zinc at 6,450 and lead at 4,500. Nickel was steady at 37,100 rupees.
